triples.subject: SatelliteLink
triples.context: While our previous work in [8] started exploration on time-domain coordination between satellite and terrestrial links for spectrum sharing, most of existing works only focused on the frequency domain [9]–[16].

triples.subject: Satellite
triples.context: Satellite selection is also considered to adapt to the case when multiple satellites are available in the satellite component.

triples.subject: BaseStation
triples.context: For generality, both full and partial frequency reuse among base stations (BSs) are supported in the terrestrial component.

triples.subject: Uav
triples.context: With the presence of a primary satellite-receiver link, multiple UA Vs with aerial stations and a terrestrial BS were deployed to support smart vehicles, and user association, power optimization, and trajectory control were jointly optimized in [12].

triples.subject: TerrestrialBaseStation
triples.context: With the presence of a primary satellite-receiver link, multiple UA Vs with aerial stations and a terrestrial BS were deployed to support smart vehicles, and user association, power optimization, and trajectory control were jointly optimized in [12].

triples.subject: Uav
triples.context: With the presence of a primary satellite-receiver link, multiple UA Vs with aerial stations and a terrestrial BS were deployed to support smart vehicles, and user association, power optimization, and trajectory control were jointly optimized in [12].

triples.subject: TerrestrialTransmitterReceiverPair
triples.context: In [10], outage probability was derived for a hybrid satellite-terrestrial system where multiple terrestrial transmitter-receiver pairs cooperate with a primary satellite network for dynamic spectrum access.

triples.subject: SatelliteMulticastDownlink
triples.context: In [11], a joint beam-forming and power allocation scheme was proposed to maximize the sum rate of satellite-terrestrial integrated networks, where the satellite multicast downlinks and the terrestrial downlinks serving a group of non-orthogonal multiple access users share the same mmWave frequency band.

triples.subject: TerrestrialDownlink
triples.context: In [11], a joint beam-forming and power allocation scheme was proposed to maximize the sum rate of satellite-terrestrial integrated networks, where the satellite multicast downlinks and the terrestrial downlinks serving a group of non-orthogonal multiple access users share the same mmWave frequency band.

triples.subject: MobileWirelessService
triples.context: With the assumption that only the mean and variance of channel gains are available for interference links, resource scheduling was discussed in [14] for mobile wireless and meteorological satellite services sharing the same frequency band.

triples.subject: HybridSatelliteTerrestrialNetwork
triples.context: With the target of maximizing both the number of served terrestrial MTs and the average sum transmission rate, a double-target spectrum sharing scheme is proposed for hybrid satellite-terrestrial networks in [16] based on large-scale CSI.
